summary.message: Responsive layout is generally solid. Two non-critical issues found: vendor name overflow in search results on mobile, and missing search filters on mobile. Breadcrumb uses proper overflow-x:scroll for long paths.

findings.description: Long vendor names (.zcnc-row-vendor) overflow the viewport on mobile. Element 'VELETA COMERCIALIZACION Y SERVICIOS SLU' extends 72.5px beyond the 390px viewport (right edge at 462.5px).
findings.impact: Users cannot see the full vendor name on mobile for listings with long business names. Content is clipped.
findings.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis + overflow: hidden + white-space: nowrap with a max-width on .zcnc-row-vendor, or wrap the text to multiple lines on mobile viewports.

findings.description: No search filters (.facet, .filter, #search_filters) found on mobile. Desktop filters are hidden (display:none) but no mobile filter toggle is displayed.
findings.impact: Mobile users searching for products cannot filter by category, price, condition, or other facets. They must scroll through all results.
findings.suggestion: Add a 'Filter' button on mobile that opens a slide-out or modal with facets, or include collapsible filter sections above results.

findings.description: Breadcrumb on PDP extends far beyond viewport (5 items, rightmost at 710px) but parent container correctly uses overflow-x:scroll, making it horizontally scrollable. This is proper responsive behavior.
findings.impact: Minor UX friction - users need to horizontal-scroll to see full breadcrumb path on mobile.
findings.suggestion: Consider truncating middle breadcrumb items on very small screens to reduce scroll distance on PDPs with deep category paths.

findings.description: Meta viewport tag is correctly set to 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1' on all pages, ensuring proper mobile scaling.
Mobile-specific UI elements are present: search bar (.ps-searchbar--mobile), login button, and collapsible footer sections. Desktop menu properly hidden via d-none d-xl-block.
findings.impact: No issue - mobile navigation works with direct links.

mobile.note: Vendor name overflow (73px) + missing mobile filters
